title: tectaria fibrillosa
intro: Tectaria fibrillosa, commonly known as the Fishbone Fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tectaria fibrillosa include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial activities, which may help in soothing sore throats and wounds. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
